annotations.text: Lifted from app/globals.css and components/icons.tsx, not redrawn by eye — every hex, radius and icon path is the value the app actually ships.
The four screens. Map tiles are stylised: OpenStreetMap can't be reached from inside a canvas, so the streets are drawn in.
Sheet shown at peek (42%). It drags to 86%, committing on distance or a flick.
The Facebook wall is the normal case, not an error state — so it hands over a paste box rather than a failure.
